title: Skeleton Cheerleaders
description: Four white skeletal figures in dynamic cheerleading poses perform on a dark theatrical stage, holding red pom-poms with sparks and smoke emanating from them. Dramatic yellow and magenta spotlights cut through the hazy air as red curtains frame the scene with floating paintings visible in the background.
